blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Is Hazelmere in Surrey or Langley?
faq.a: Surrey — it is a board sub-area of the S Surrey White Rock community in the City of Surrey's South Surrey community, at the city's south-east corner; Campbell Valley Regional Park and the Township of Langley lie to the east, outside the sub-area.

faq.q: How did Hazelmere sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 7 active listings, 2 solds and a 29% sales ratio — the highest detached ratio in the S Surrey White Rock set that month, on the set's smallest base — and Condos & Townhomes recorded 2 listings with no sales; medians are published at community level only (S Surrey White Rock detached $1,628,000; attached $700,000) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is Hazelmere in the ALR, and what housing does the ALR allow?
faq.a: ALR status is parcel-specific and no Hazelmere parcel result is stated in this file. Where a parcel is in the ALR, the ALC's published frame is: one principal residence up to 500 m², a secondary suite only inside that residence where local bylaws allow it, and at most one additional detached residence of up to 90 m² (parcels 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (parcels over 40 ha), with local zoning able to be more restrictive.

faq.q: Which school is physically in Hazelmere?
faq.a: Xw'epiteng Elementary, 18035 8 Ave, confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file; nearby confirmed schools are East Kensington Elementary (2795 184 St), Douglas Elementary (17325 2 Ave) and Earl Marriott Secondary (15751 16 Ave). Catchments are address-based in SD36 and no Hazelmere locator result is on record, so check the exact address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can a Hazelmere acreage add the usual Surrey SSMUH units?
faq.a: Generally not on the standard framing: Surrey's SSMUH allowances apply to eligible residential-zoned properties under 4,050 m² inside the Urban Containment Boundary, with exemptions including lands not connected to community water and sewer. Hazelmere's acreage lots need a parcel-level check of zone, containment boundary and servicing before any added-unit claim.
